documents.description: Search published Federal Register documents (rules, proposed rules, notices, presidential documents) since 1994. Filters are conditions[...] parameters; at most 10,000 documents per query.

conditions[type][].desc: RULE | PRORULE | NOTICE | PRESDOCU (a list gives several)

conditions[agencies][].desc: agency slug(s), e.g. environmental-protection-agency (endpoint 'agencies' lists them)

conditions[president][].desc: president slug: donald-trump, joe-biden, barack-obama, george-w-bush, william-j-clinton

conditions[signing_date][gte].desc: presidential documents signed on or after YYYY-MM-DD

conditions[significant].desc: 1 = deemed significant under EO 12866 (Unified Agenda flag)

conditions[correction].desc: 0 = leave out correction notices (default), 1 = only corrections

fields[].desc: list of fields to return (default: a useful set; see source.md)

executive_orders.description: Executive orders (documents with type PRESDOCU and presidential_document_type executive_order); filter by president, year or words.

conditions[president][].desc: president slug, e.g. donald-trump, joe-biden, barack-obama

document_counts.description: Counts of documents matching the same conditions[...] filters, grouped by a facet: daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly, agency, topic, section, type, subtype. One row per group (key, name, count).

conditions[correction].desc: 0 = leave out corrections (counts include them by default, as OFR's statistics do)

document.description: One document's full metadata: dates, docket, RIN, CFR references, comment deadline, links to full text.

public_inspection_current.description: Documents on public inspection now: filed and scheduled for publication (usually the next business day).

public_inspection.description: Documents that were on public inspection on a given date.

agencies.description: Every Federal Register agency: id, name, short name, slug (use the slug in conditions[agencies][]), parent.

rules.name: Final rules
rules.description: conditions[type][] = RULE: final rules and interim final rules

proposed_rules.name: Proposed rules
proposed_rules.description: conditions[type][] = PRORULE: notices of proposed rulemaking, ANPRMs

notices.name: Notices
notices.description: conditions[type][] = NOTICE: agency notices (meetings, grants, determinations)

presidential_documents.name: Presidential documents
presidential_documents.description: conditions[type][] = PRESDOCU: executive orders, proclamations, memoranda, determinations

executive_orders.name: Executive orders
executive_orders.description: endpoint executive_orders: EOs by president, year or words

counts_by_year.name: Document counts by year
counts_by_year.description: endpoint document_counts with facet yearly: rule or EO counts per year
